### Improvements
- Added custom views in popover previews and embedded notes, with shared templates and optional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript overrides for each context.
- Used [Knap](https://github.com/obsidianmd/knap) for filter-chain parsing and shared filters, while preserving Custom Views compatibility where behavior differs. Available filters are also included in editor suggestions.
- Added per-view enable toggles and inline renaming, with clearer action icons and keyboard controls.
- Improved template settings layout using native Obsidian setting groups and inline code formatting.
- Improved editor suggestions with fuzzy matching, highlighted matches, language-specific icons, and Obsidian's default suggestion font size.
- Reduced idle work through embed, layout, and metadata events on supported Obsidian versions, and cached parsed expressions across notes and loop iterations.
- Removed obsolete navigation experiments, diagnostic scripts, and internal audit artifacts.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed the previous note's content appearing in filtered templates when switching notes, including unstacked tabs.
- Fixed stale source caching when a note changes during an asynchronous read.
- Fixed Canvas reading-mode requests unnecessarily removing an already-mounted custom view.
- Kept embedded views visible while switching modes and waiting for the live editor's layout, with a timeout fallback when animation frames stop.
- Fixed redundant embedded renders and prevented superseded callbacks from resetting newer views.
- Refreshed embedded views when linked-note dependencies change.
- Fixed live-editor handoff using an obsolete editor instance.
- Fixed Escape closing the template dialog before dismissing editor completions or search, and cleaned up rename keyboard handlers when settings refresh.
- Updated test dependencies to address vulnerability advisories.

### Tests
- Expanded regression coverage for note switching, editor handoff, asynchronous source reads, embedded transitions, and linked-note updates.
- Added coverage for per-view toggles, inline renaming, settings layout, and completion icons.
- Added Knap compatibility checks for typed filter results, regex alternation, and encoded HTML.
- Passed all 1,248 tests, lint, type checks, and the production build.
